answerText:
{
"final_product_goal": "mdpr-skill should act as an evidence-first coherence and design-order review layer for Markdown-to-PPTX generation: narrative, source evidence, chart semantics, theme-bound guidance, and MDPR validation references must be sequenced before any rendering decision, while MDPR retains final parsing, layout, PPTX objects, theme resolution, and pass/fail validation. ",
"assessment": "The current implementation has a solid base but is not yet strict enough at deck level. It already defines scientific chart design-order steps, evidence-only chart intent reports, theme-slot visual guidance, and tests that reject final geometry/raw values/color leakage.   The weak point is that ordering is strongest inside scientific chart reports, while broader deck coherence still mainly checks detached captions, orphan evidence, claimless evidence, section rhythm, and selection grouping; it does not yet enforce a single deck-level chain from narrative spine to evidence ledger to chart intent to visual guidance to MDPR validation refs.   Office already supports many native chart families, so mdpr-skill should continue expressing non-basic/scientific chart needs as semantic capability requests rather than renderer choices. ([Microsoft 지원][1])",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Add a deck-level design-order trace schema",
"why": "Current chart reports encode the sequence `data_evidence -> scientific_chart_intent -> semantic_visual_guidance -> renderer_capability_request -> review_notes`, but the same order is not enforced across narrative spine, evidence ledger, template/layout intent, visual guidance, and MDPR validation refs. This leaves room for agents to choose style/theme guidance before the claim, evidence, and chart semantics are stable.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md",
"docs/agent-hint-guide.md",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Introduce a `DeckDesignOrderTrace` or equivalent report with ordered stages for `narrative_spine`, `source_evidence`, `slide_role`, `chart_intent`, `semantic_visual_guidance`, `theme_binding_request`, `mdpr_validation_refs`, and `review_notes`.",
"Emit warnings when a later-stage artifact exists without required earlier-stage evidence, for example visual guidance without claim/evidence refs.",
"All entries must carry evidence refs and must exclude raw colors, coordinates, fixed PPTX geometry, renderer object IDs, and final validation verdicts.",
"Add tests for clean order, missing narrative before chart intent, visual guidance before evidence, and boundary-field rejection."
]
},
{
"title": "Connect chart visual guidance to narrative spine and slide role",
"why": "`ChartVisualApplicationGuidance` now has chart choice, tone slots, background treatment, label strategy, and density strategy, but it is not explicitly tied to the deck-level claim, section purpose, or slide role. Without that bridge, a chart can be semantically valid but narratively misplaced.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"docs/infographic-seed-guide.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Extend chart-intent entries or add a companion review finding with `narrativeClaimRef`, `slideRole`, `sectionRef`, and `evidenceLedgerRefs`.",
"Warn when a `primary-visual` chart has no explicit claim/title support or when a `supporting-proof` chart is placed without a nearby evidence claim.",
"Warn when chart intent and slide role are incoherent, for example dense matrix evidence on a section-divider role.",
"Tests prove CDF/distribution/error-bar/matrix guidance remains semantic and theme-bound only."
]
},
{
"title": "Add cross-slide semantic motif consistency checks",
"why": "Existing coherence checks cover section rhythm drift, but not repeated semantic motifs across slides. The same evidence role or scientific chart intent should not randomly shift between primary visual, supporting proof, comparison strip, or small multiple unless there is a narrative reason.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add findings such as `SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT` or `CHART_ROLE_DRIFT` based on intent kind, slide role, chart choice, and theme-slot category.",
"Flag unexplained shifts in repeated chart/evidence roles across a section.",
"Do not compare raw colors or geometry; compare semantic theme slots, chart role, background treatment category, and density strategy class.",
"Add positive tests for intentional section transition and negative tests for accidental repeated-motif drift."
]
},
{
"title": "Make same-slide evidence binding stricter",
"why": "The current tests distinguish detached captions, orphan evidence, claimless evidence, and clean claim-plus-caption cases. That is necessary but still shallow: it does not verify whether the claim actually references the chart/table/image semantics or whether the evidence is used to support the slide’s stated takeaway.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add a `CHART_NARRATIVE_ALIGNMENT_GAP` or `EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP` finding when evidence blocks and claim text have no shared metric, entity, source ref, or declared semantic role.",
"Keep this heuristic evidence-only and warning-level unless MDPR supplies deterministic validation refs.",
"Clean cases pass when claim, caption, evidence block, and source/evidence ledger refs align.",
"No final style, object geometry, or subjective visual-quality decision is produced."
]
},
{
"title": "Structure density guidance as machine-checkable review data",
"why": "Label and density strategies currently exist as prose inside visual application guidance. That is useful for humans but weak for automated ordering and coherence checks, especially when deciding whether dense charts should be primary visuals, small multiples, background proof, or summarized evidence.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md",
"docs/renderer-capability-guide.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Add structured fields such as `densityClass`, `labelBudgetClass`, `recommendedDownshift`, and `aggregationRequired` while keeping the existing prose strategies.",
"Emit warnings when dense evidence is marked as `primary-visual` without downshift, aggregation, small-multiple, or capability-request notes.",
"Tests cover dense matrix, high-label-count chart, clean sparse chart, and unsupported-renderer fallback cases.",
"The output remains a recommendation to MDPR, not a final layout or rendering instruction."
]
},
{
"title": "Add an explicit design-order validator for generated review artifacts",
"why": "Tests already verify some boundary constraints, for example no coordinates, no raw values, no raw color markers, and chart design order starting with data evidence. The missing guard is a reusable validator that checks all review artifacts for stage order, evidence refs, and boundary leakage.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"tests/test_boundary_contract.py",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Expose a reusable `validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder` or equivalent function.",
"Validate chart intent reports, visual guidance reports, source-slide evidence ledgers, and future deck design-order traces.",
"Reject or flag final-decision keys already listed in the code boundary set, including coordinates, raw color keys, renderer object IDs, recipe IDs, and geometry. ",
"Add tests where artifacts fail for missing evidence refs, out-of-order stages, and final-decision-field leakage."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [
{
"title": "MDPR final validation-ref contract",
"why_not_local": "mdpr-skill can request and consume MDPR validation refs, but MDPR owns parsing, layout, rendering, PPTX/PDF output, theme resolution, and final pass/fail validation. "
},
{
"title": "MDPR renderer capability matrix for scientific and non-basic charts",
"why_not_local": "mdpr-skill can produce semantic chart intent and capability requests, but native chart, custom editable object, fallback rendering, and unsupported-capability decisions belong to the MDPR runtime. "
},
{
"title": "Manual final deck visual approval",
"why_not_local": "Manual visual approval is outside locally actionable implementation because the requested scope excludes manual visual inspection; mdpr-skill should only provide evidence-backed review notes and not a subjective beauty gate."
}
],
"non_goals": [
"Do not add raw XLSX/workbook values, formulas, extracted chart coordinates, raw colors, or fixed PPTX geometry to mdpr-skill.",
"Do not make mdpr-skill the final owner of chart rendering, layout, theme resolution, PPTX objects, or validation pass/fail.",
"Do not convert semantic chart guidance into final agent decisions about exact coordinates, palettes, object IDs, or renderer primitives.",
"Do not use subjective visual preference as a local release gate."
]
}

[1]: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Available chart types in Office"
